desc:
FREE CODE: LIKES100

🌍 Build your mini city, take care of your citizens and see what they get up to!

⭐ How to Play:

- Buy buildings in the shop and build your city! 🏠
- Wait for construction to finish and collect coins! 💰
- Expand your land! 🗺️
- Help your citizens whenever they need you! 🚨
- Wait for the shop to restock and buy rare buildings! ✨

💬 Your citizens have a life of their own: they chat, argue, dance, cry and nap on the streets… and they always have a surprise for you! 👀

Start with a tiny house and turn your world into the happiest and richest city ever! ⭐

👍 If you enjoy the game, leave a thumbs up!
🐞 Found a bug? Report it on our community!

Remember: your buildings keep getting built and making you money even while you’re offline ⭐
